objective: product_price * sum of produce - sum over months and oils of price * buy - holding_cost * sum of store

order.description: Position in the planning horizon (1 = first month)
order.label: month order

category.description: Refining line the oil goes through: veg (vegetable) or nonveg (non-vegetable); an oil with any other category cannot be refined
category.label: oil category

hardness.description: Hardness of the raw oil; the blend's hardness is the tonnage-weighted average of the oils refined
hardness.label: oil hardness

price.description: Price of buying one ton of the oil in the month; with no row for a (month, oil) pair the oil cannot be bought that month
price.label: purchase price

product_price.description: Sale price of the blended food product
product_price.label: food product price

veg_refining_capacity.description: Tons of vegetable oil the vegetable refining line can process per month
veg_refining_capacity.label: vegetable oil refining capacity

nonveg_refining_capacity.description: Tons of non-vegetable oil the non-vegetable refining line can process per month
nonveg_refining_capacity.label: non-vegetable oil refining capacity

min_hardness.description: Lowest hardness allowed for the blended product
min_hardness.label: minimum product hardness

max_hardness.description: Highest hardness allowed for the blended product
max_hardness.label: maximum product hardness

holding_cost.description: Storage cost per ton of raw oil held at a month end
holding_cost.label: oil storage cost

storage_capacity.description: Maximum tons of each raw oil that can be in storage at a month end
storage_capacity.label: storage capacity per oil

initial_stock.description: Tons of each raw oil in storage at the start of the first month
initial_stock.label: opening stock per oil

final_stock.description: Tons of each raw oil that must be in storage at the end of the last month
final_stock.label: closing stock target per oil

decision_variables.buy[month, oil]: tons of raw oil bought (>= 0; fixed to 0 when the month has no purchase price for the oil)
decision_variables.consume[month, oil]: tons of raw oil refined and blended into the product (>= 0); 'Use' in the notebook
decision_variables.store[month, oil]: tons of raw oil in storage at the month end (0..storage_capacity)
decision_variables.produce[month]: tons of food product made and sold (>= 0)

constraints.initial_balance[oil]: initial_stock + buy[first month] = consume[first month] + store[first month]
constraints.balance[month, oil]: store[previous month] + buy = consume + store, for every month after the first
constraints.horizon_closure[oil]: store[last month] + buy[first month] - consume[first month] - store[first month] = final_stock - initial_stock (the notebook's wrap-around first-month balance row; implied by initial_balance and end_stock)
constraints.refining[category, month]: sum of consume over the oils of the category <= that line's refining capacity (veg_refining_capacity or nonveg_refining_capacity)
constraints.hardness_min[month]: sum over oils of hardness * consume >= min_hardness * produce
constraints.hardness_max[month]: sum over oils of hardness * consume <= max_hardness * produce
constraints.mass_balance[month]: sum over oils of consume = produce (refining loses no mass)
